markdownRemark.html:
Valvoline

Software Engineer

This project was about trust at scale.

When someone selects the wrong product for their vehicle, that is not just a UI issue. It affects confidence, service outcomes, and brand trust.

The Real Scenario

A customer enters vehicle details and expects a clear recommendation.

If results are slow, inconsistent, or confusing, they leave uncertain or choose the wrong product.

My work focused on making that decision flow dependable and easy to trust.

What I Owned

  • Built compatibility and recommendation services powering product selection flows.
  • Improved product lookup APIs for faster, clearer responses.
  • Helped clean and validate vehicle and catalog data feeding the recommendation engine.
  • Diagnosed production issues and hardened fragile workflows under real traffic.
  • Collaborated with product and business teams to translate operations pain into shipped features.

Scrappy Startup Moments

1. Data quality was the hidden product problem

The interface could look clean, but bad source data could still produce bad outcomes.

I added stronger validation checks and safer ingestion behavior to prevent silent errors from reaching users.

2. Recommendation logic had to be practical, not theoretical

We needed rules that worked in real service contexts, not just ideal scenarios.

I helped tune compatibility logic and response behavior around real-world usage patterns.

3. Production reliability mattered every day

Issues surfaced fast because usage was broad.

I was hands-on with debugging and fixes, improving stability while still delivering new capabilities.

Human Impact

  • Users got clearer guidance and higher confidence in product choices.
  • Service teams dealt with fewer edge-case failures.
  • Internal teams could ship faster because core workflows were more stable.

What I'd Build Next

  • Better explainability on why a specific product is recommended.
  • Automated anomaly detection for vehicle-product mismatch patterns.
  • More operational dashboards for faster issue detection and triage.
